SELECT rd.*
FROM eam_car_material_requisition_detail rd
WHERE rd.is_del = 0
  AND (
        rd.detail_status = 'act'
        OR NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM eam_car_material_requisition_detail a
              WHERE a.requisition_id = rd.requisition_id
                AND a.is_del = 0
                AND a.detail_status = 'act'
                AND a.line_number = rd.line_number
           )
      )
ORDER BY rd.requisition_id, rd.line_number;
